component.name: UDownload
component.summary: Fast GTK4 download manager with browser integration

description.p: UDownload is a native GTK4/libadwaita download manager powered by aria2. It supports segmented downloads, pause and resume, queues, scheduling, batch link selection and browser integration.
Add an optional browser-based Web UI with configurable port, live queue control, and LAN/VPN access managed from UDM Options or the command line.
Add SSH Remote control and local CLI commands, resolve filenames before CLI insertion, and keep active-row context menus open during live refreshes.
Move progress actions into the dialog footer and remove the redundant Close button.
Make Pause and Cancel terminate the real aria2 transfer, stop duplicate GIDs writing the same file, and resume partial files with an exact locked output path.
Fix progress-dialog Pause, Resume and Cancel state races by waiting for confirmed aria2 state transitions without blocking GTK.
Add minimize-to-list and double-click progress reopening, and fix pause/resume dialog state synchronization.
Add a download-complete dialog with drag-and-drop, restore progress windows on resume, and repair Chrome native messaging.
Add an IDM-style download info/progress workflow and make row context menus work across the full row area.
Add an IDM-style queue scheduler with schedule controls, queue files, retries and completion actions.
Add file properties, double-click details and an IDM-style right-click download menu.
Fix ETA display, add progress percentage, autofill clipboard URLs and avoid filename collisions.
Resolve indirect download metadata and preserve server-provided filenames.
